tldr: Mars through the 5th house heats up dating, pleasure, creativity, and what makes life feel alive.
body:
When Mars moves through your 5th house, it adds heat and urgency to dating, pleasure, creativity, children, sex, attention, joy, and whether life still feels alive. You may notice what you want to create, who you want to enjoy, and where life has started to feel too flat or overly managed.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making room for desire, play, and creative risk.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is chasing a spark without asking whether it is actually nourishing you.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
